activity_summary: Before daylight you stayed upstairs. You had told Anne the girl was quick, and you had come to bed. The sheet was still in the orchard under the stone. You did not go down to it in the dark.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke low, and did not leave the chamber.

entities.name: the orchard scene
entities.context: Mentioned in Said the girl was quick

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not going down to it before there is light.
